label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) alert-TP: java.util.Random().nextLong() generates rememberMeKey used in cookies/session attributes - cryptographically weak RNG for security-sensitive material. Alert 2 (xss) alert-TP: param from cookie -> doSomething() -> bar -> response.getWriter() printed without encoding - user input reaches HTML sink. Both alerts have verified attack paths.

evidence.note: Weak RNG (java.util.Random) used for rememberMeKey which becomes cookie value
XSS sink: bar (from user cookie via doSomething) printed to response without encoding
